# Disclosure Policy

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:DisclosurePolicy`](gmeow-DisclosurePolicy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/DisclosurePolicy>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)

The disclosure posture of a value or claim — an open value vocabulary of individuals (never subclasses) classifying whether and under what conditions the fact may be projected to consumers. The *what* layer of disclosure control: internalOnly, sensitive, publicCareful, publicSafe, neverPublic, or publicOnlyWithIndependentSource. Orthogonal to sensitivity, determinacy, confidence, and granularity ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). The conditional case (publicOnlyWithIndependentSource) is resolved against the evidence module's [`sourceIndependence`](../properties/gmeow-sourceIndependence.md) axis in the solver layer (P12).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:DisclosurePolicy`](gmeow-DisclosurePolicy.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
